question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Personnel .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Personnel** is correctly spelt and refers to people employed in an organization or engaged in a particular activity.
 
• Option 2 (**Personel**) is incorrect because it is missing an additional 'n'.
 
• Option 3 (**Personeel**) is incorrect as it has an extra 'e'.
 
• Option 4 (**Persnell**) is incorrect due to a spelling error and deviation from the correct form.

Correct usage: *The company is hiring new **personnel** to improve efficiency.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly Confused Words:**
 
 
• **Personnel:** Refers to employees or staff.
 
• **Personal:** Refers to something private or belonging to an individual.
 
 
 
• **Tips to Avoid Spelling Errors:**
 
 
• Break the word into syllables: Per-son-nel.
 
• Practice writing the word multiple times to build memory.
